text:
Mae: quick idea — can we add a lightweight 'query snapshot' that pins a route+model+filters combo so PMs and SREs can jump to a known-good view? :thinking:
Jon: sounds handy. is this just a saved query or something more ephemeral?
Mae: different from saved queries — think of it as a UX affordance on the route page: pin an active snapshot (model variant, filter set, timeframe, telemetry tags). visible inline, low friction to create.
Sam: UX note: make it 1-click to pin current state, and surface who pinned it + last run. otherwise we'll get a mess of anonymous pins.
Lucy: also need guardrails: who can pin to a shared route vs personal. RBAC ties to savedquery ownership?
Nora: from infra side, we must ensure these snapshots don't explode the query table. maybe store diffs or reference existing saved queries by id.
Jon: implementation thought: a snapshot record is {route_id, model_id, filter_hash, base_saved_query_id?, created_by, shared_scope}. We can index by filter_hash.
Mae: what about telemetry? we want snapshots to capture telemetry sample rates & compare baseline metrics.
Sam: show a small sparkline and the model/route token cost avg. hover to expand.
Lucy: rollout UX — default to personal, allow owners to promote to team with 2-step confirm. can add a 'pin to console header' for critical routes.
Jon: API sketch:
```
POST /api/v1/console/snapshots
{
  "route": "payments/charge",
  "model": "redwood-ggml-7b-q4",
  "filters": {"status": "error", "latency_ms_gt": 300},
  "scope": "team",
  "name": "High-latency errors (model A)"
}
```
Mae: +1 to including scope in the API. We also need a way to link to a snapshot from alerts and runbooks.
Nora: quotas concern — if someone pins a snapshot that triggers heavy replay/compare jobs, we need safeguards. snapshots should be display-only unless you explicitly click 'run comparison' which enqueues a job under the user's quota.
Lucy: UX: show a tiny CTA on snapshot: [View] [Compare] [Promote] — compare kicks off job with a clear cost estimate.
Sam: permissions matrix: personal snapshots (private), team snapshots (anyone on team can edit if owner allows), route-owned snapshots (requires route-admin). We'll need an API param for editability.
Jon: storage plan: store compact filter JSON and keep a 30-day revision history, older snapshots get archived. index by route+model for fast lookup on route page.
Mae: how to present per-model vs per-route? propose tabs: Model snapshots (all variants pinned by team) vs Route snapshots (per-route pins). filter fallback: when model pinned but model isn't available, show fallback model suggestion and reason.
Nora: add routing policy metadata — if a snapshot pins a model variant that is only served on Dedicated, show region/policy hints so users understand availability.
Lucy: quick mock request: can someone make a tiny wire showing the header pin UI? I'll attach to the PR.
Sam: I'll do a 2-screen mock by EOD.
Jon: I'll start a backend draft and add the schema to the internal API spec.
Mae: final ask: add telemetry tags to snapshots so we can run automated quality checks on promote. e.g., metric_signatures: [latency_p90, error_rate].
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: migrations for snapshots schema will run in staging at 23:00 UTC. :robot_face:
Lucy: noted re migration window.
Mae: cool — let's sync tomorrow in the product checkin. :thumbsup:
